operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are simple ASCII, no spaces/mixed case; but DDL has tabs and multi-line CREATE TABLE — line-based unique/check scan must tolerate tabs.
No NOT NULL, no UNIQUE, no CHECK anywhere; every column nullable, so TS's NULL injection is never blocked by constraints.
Member_of, Minor_in, Enrolled_in have NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op on empty PK, not crash.

Enrolled_in.Grade is a VARCHAR(2) FK to Gradeconversion.lettergrade (text->text, fine) but Grade values like 'A-','B+' are 1-2 chars; String fuzzer length range [0,2] will produce junk that fails the FK at insert (skipped).
Course.CID is VARCHAR(7) PK with dotted codes '050.102'; String fuzzer will emit random 0-7 char strings, many colliding -> PK dedupe drops rows.
Student.Advisor is INTEGER but NOT declared as FK to Faculty.FacID; TS treats it as plain Number, so advisor values will not match any FacID (semantic FK, not schema FK).
Student.Major is INTEGER with no FK to Department.DNO; same semantic-FK gap.
Course.Hours is VARCHAR(11) holding both '3' and '10:30-12' — mixed numeric/time text; String fuzzer, not Time (declared type has no 'time').
Course.Days VARCHAR(5) holds 'MTW','Th','MW' — day-code text, String fuzzer.
Gradeconversion.gradepoint is FLOAT stored as real; Number fuzzer with scale from no args -> default scale, will emit values far outside [0,4].
Faculty.Phone and Department.DPhone are INTEGER phone numbers (4-digit); Number fuzzer range will produce huge/negative ints.
All tables tiny (10-210 rows); no huge-table sampling concern, but original_values lists are short so 5-draw rng.choices with replacement is heavily duplicated.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on StuID/FacID/DNO/Credits/Age/Phone: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 perturbation; PKs like 1001-1034 will be replaced by arbitrary ints, breaking joins to literal '1001' in gold SQL -> FN.
String fuzzer on LName/Fname/DName/CName: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length 0-12/15/25/40; gold SQL filtering on 'Smith','Biology' etc. returns empty -> FN.
String fuzzer on Sex VARCHAR(1): random 0-1 char strings, not 'M'/'F'; gold 'Sex = M' queries get empty -> FN.
String fuzzer on Rank VARCHAR(15): random strings, not 'Professor'/'Instructor'; gold rank filters -> FN.
String fuzzer on Gradeconversion.lettergrade VARCHAR(2) PK: random 0-2 char strings; Enrolled_in.Grade FK draws from these, so Grade values become junk; gold 'Grade = A' -> FN.
String fuzzer on Course.CID VARCHAR(7): random strings, not '050.102'; gold CID filters and joins to Enrolled_in.CID -> FN.
String fuzzer on Division VARCHAR(2): random 0-2 chars, not 'AS'/'EN' -> FN on division filters.
String fuzzer on Building VARCHAR(13): random strings, not 'NEB'/'Mudd' -> FN on building filters.
String fuzzer on city_code VARCHAR(3): random 0-3 chars, not 'BAL'/'HKG' -> FN.
Number fuzzer on gradepoint FLOAT: uniform over huge range, not [0,4]; gold 'gradepoint > 3.5' -> mostly true or mostly false -> FP/FN.

FK columns (Member_of.FacID/DNO, Course.Instructor/DNO, Minor_in.StuID/DNO, Enrolled_in.StuID/CID/Grade) draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement -> many duplicate child rows; no PK on these tables so duplicates survive -> FP on COUNT(DISTINCT) vs COUNT queries.

PK dedupe on Student/Faculty/Department/Course/Gradeconversion keeps first occurrence; with random Number/String PKs collisions are rare for ints but common for short VARCHAR PKs (lettergrade, CID) -> table sizes shrink below chosen size -> FP on COUNT(*) queries.
